newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kurds facing deportation hide in U.S. Bonn embassy.
newsitem.headline: Kurds facing deportation hide in U.S. Bonn embassy.

text.p: Twenty-two ethnic Kurds from Armenia slipped into the U.S. embassy in Bonn on Wednesday in an attempt to avoid being deported from Germany, an embassy spokesman said.
He said they entered the compound by foot at 10.20 a.m. by hiding behind a vehicle as it passed through a guarded entrance.

"It appeared that some had poured gasoline on themselves," the spokesman said. "It was a gesture we took seriously. We had people standing by with fire extinguishers. The gas evaporated and no one was hurt."

A Bonn police spokesman said police were negotiating with the Kurds to leave the compound. He said several members of the group, which had been living in the central German town of Paderborn, had been ordered to leave the country by the end of April because their applications for asylum had been rejected.
The spokesman said they had been offered bus transport back to Paderborn, 200 km (125 miles) east of Bonn.
